exploratory_status: Designed after observing Shallow-v1, drift-v1, and calibration-gate diagnostics.

primary_operating_point.DeltaH: parameter-free length-adaptive drift correction using cumulative depths 128 and 256
primary_operating_point.selection: global raw-prefix DeltaNLL stable sort, remove exact 2000 lowest and 2000 highest; then stable corrected-DeltaH sort and select exact 2000

secondary_operating_point.mechanism: same asymmetric method: raw prefix-128 DeltaNLL + drift-corrected DeltaH from depths 64->128
secondary_operating_point.purpose: aggressive compute operating point / frontier analysis

supporting_calibration_gate.role: supporting evidence that an independently frozen 500-example calibration gate selects the same raw-DeltaNLL / corrected-DeltaH asymmetry
